scope_findings.claim: The action recruits Bulgarian researcher Dr. Rositsa Cholakova to the Hungarian host HUN-REN ATK, involving cross-border international mobility of the researcher.
The fellowship is applied for jointly by the researcher and a beneficiary in the academic sector (HUN-REN ATK), with supervision by Dr. Roland Hollos.
The action is a European Postdoctoral Fellowship comprising a 24-month European Fellowship at ATK, within the standard 12-24 month duration for European Postdoctoral Fellowships.
The project includes a 6-month non-academic placement at AgroVIR (Hungary, an EU Member State) during M25-M30 at the end of the project, as an integral evaluated part of the proposal.
FIELDWISE builds and validates a physiologically grounded water-stress prediction framework for processing tomato from physiological, soil-water, meteorological and proximal spectral observations.
scope_findings.flag_reason: MSCA-PF scope_requirements.json defines only structural/eligibility scope elements (mobility, duration, sectors, training, CDP) and contains no thematic/topical scope element for this bottom-up call; no Tier 2B scope element found to confirm this thematic research claim is in-scope. Scope boundary is defined by Tier 2B only.
